title: Industrial Exoskeletons
supports: Task-specific potential benefit; fit, mobility and transferred risks require evaluation; address residual risk after feasible engineering controls.
limits: Older research commentary, not a device certification or proof of long-term injury reduction. Do not treat its research snapshot as the entire 2026 evidence base.

title: Science and Tech Spotlight Wearable Technologies in the Workplace
supports: Workplace wearable adoption can face cost and usability barriers; published efficacy evidence is limited.
limits: Broad wearable overview. Sensor privacy issues cannot automatically be attributed to a passive device with no electronics.

title: About Ergonomics and Work Related Musculoskeletal Disorders
supports: Design work and job demands around worker capabilities; evaluate physical and psychosocial risk factors.
limits: General methodological guidance, not a local task assessment or a legal opinion.
